groups.sentence: Nobody uses AI to create or distribute malware, phishing or other malicious content, or uploads data that helps do so.
Students do not use AI to fabricate or falsify data, results, sources, citations or other evidence in their work.
Students do not use AI to hide plagiarism, evade detection, or mislead others about where their work came from.
Nobody uses AI to generate or spread misinformation or false, misleading or harmful content, including deepfakes.
Instructors do not misrepresent AI-generated content as original work.
Students take care to avoid unintentional plagiarism or data fabrication when using AI.
Instructors and researchers may intentionally use AI to produce deceptive content for pedagogical or research purposes.
Submitting fabricated data, counterfeit citations or misinformation through AI is misuse.
Nobody uses AI to create discriminatory, defamatory, harmful or obscene content.
Nobody uses AI for illegal, fraudulent or unlawful activity.
Nobody uses AI to harass, bully, stalk, intimidate or sexually exploit others.
Nobody uses AI to threaten, bypass or gain unauthorized access to university systems, security or controls.
Everyone avoids using AI to deceive, mislead, manipulate or misrepresent others, including fraudulent deepfakes.
Everyone does not use AI to fabricate, falsify or alter data, research results, academic content or other information.
Nobody uses AI to create false or forged records, such as academic records, recommendations or medical excuses.
Nobody uses AI for unauthorized surveillance, monitoring or collection of personal information about individuals.
AI can be used to deceive, spread misinformation, or harm people and the university's work.
Nobody uses AI tools to facilitate academic dishonesty or gain an unfair advantage.
Nobody uses AI to impersonate real people, including instructors or students, through text, images, audio or video.
AI can access, manipulate or disrupt university systems.
